executiveAssessment.text:
Executive Conclusion. Casas del XVI's most important issue is concentrated competitive displacement by JW Marriott Hotel Santo Domingo, not a vague visibility problem.

What the Data Is Telling Us. JW Marriott Hotel Santo Domingo appears in 37 monitored scenarios where Casas del XVI is absent. That concentration matters more than a long competitor list because it identifies a repeatable substitution pattern. Related Reality Gap pressure includes Soft Brand / Independence at 0% recognition, which may help explain why the hotel is not carried into those answers.

Why It Matters. Leadership needs to understand why specific alternatives are surfaced instead of Casas del XVI in recurring demand contexts. Otherwise attention may stay on average scores while missing the concentrated leak. A displacement pattern that repeats is more actionable than a soft overall visibility narrative.

Where the Pattern Is Concentrated. Business Travel shows the softest Scenario Capture (9.1%), while Family Travel remains stronger (66.7%). That contrast supports a concentrated softness reading — not a uniform demand failure. InterContinental Real Santo Domingo most often appears when the hotel is absent (37 scenarios) — useful for source and fact reconciliation, not as proof of cause. Reality Coverage is 40.0% (6/15 attributes). Material gaps include Soft Brand / Independence; IHG One Rewards Loyalty; Wedding Venue.

What Management Should Focus On Now. Focus first on the demand contexts where JW Marriott Hotel Santo Domingo is consistently surfaced instead of Casas del XVI. Determine whether the relevant attributes and use cases are clearly represented across priority sources, and whether the hotel's own proposition is complete for those same contexts.

What Not to Overreact To. No comparable prior official monitoring period is available yet. This period can be evaluated on its own; change over time is not shown. Independent Positioning (#2 of 5; Portfolio AI Presence 31.7%) uses a different denominator than Core consideration — treat it as relative portfolio context, not a second Core score.

What to Review Next. Open the underlying displacement evidence for JW Marriott Hotel Santo Domingo and compare attributes cited in those answers with Casas del XVI's first-party and major travel-source representation. Confirm whether the same cues appear when the hotel is present.
